verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents that its AI Auto Drafts can "insert availability" into replies using calendar context. Users can also give the drafting and scheduling features instructions like "use this booking link", so availability and booking links can reach an email through AI-generated drafts. However, no dedicated, user-invoked command for sharing availability or inserting bookable time slots is documented, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: a documented manual share-availability or insert-time-slots feature in the composer, a description of bookable or clickable meeting times for recipients, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my availability or insert bookable meeting times directly into an email

citations.quote: They can use information from other emails, insert availability, and conduct research online.
Add plain-language instructions like "write in lowercase" or "use this booking link" to personalize your writing and scheduling features.
Each draft can use your inbox, calendar, and the web to write replies that are ready to send.
